title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: KMP target coverage at a glance
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.31.0 adds inline badges on expect declarations that show which Kotlin Multiplatform targets have a matching actual implementation.

highlights.title: KMP Target Coverage Badges
highlights.description: Shows which platform targets implement each expect declaration directly in the editor, so gaps in your Kotlin Multiplatform coverage are visible without opening every actual file.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Added inline badges on expect declarations showing which Kotlin Multiplatform targets have a matching actual implementation, making platform coverage visible at a glance instead of requiring a manual check per target.
Available in both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.
Can be turned off via the kotlinJump.kmpTargetBadges setting.
